desc: Upgrade your kitchen with the GE Countertop Microwave Oven, a 950 watt 1.1 cu ft microwave designed for fast, even cooking and everyday convenience. This stainless microwave delivers reliable performance as a counter top microwave for kitchens, a dorm microwave, or a microwave for office use. Featuring one-touch controls and 6 convenience cook settings, this microwave oven countertop model makes cooking simple and efficient. The digital display and electronic keypad provide precise control, while the defrost function ensures evenly thawed food without overcooking edges. A glass turntable promotes consistent heating for better results. Built with trusted GE performance, this microwave countertop small space solution is ideal for a dorm room microwave, college dorm microwave, or kitchen microwave setup. The child lock adds safety for shared spaces, making this microwave compact, dependable, and easy to use for daily meals.
